connector.name: Bridgistic
connector.registryDescription: Connect Claude to WordPress safely: signed requests, scoped keys, approvals, logs, snapshots.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package bridgistic-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the shubochandrosarker account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: BRIDGISTIC_SITE_URL
env.description: WordPress site URL exactly as shown in WP Admin → Settings → General, e.g. https://example.com

env.name: BRIDGISTIC_KEY_ID
env.description: Public key id (wpk_…) from WP Admin → Bridgistic → Claude Setup

env.name: BRIDGISTIC_KEY_SECRET
env.description: Key secret (wps_…) shown once at key creation

env.name: BRIDGISTIC_CONNECTIONS
env.description: Optional absolute path to a multi-site connections JSON registry (alias → siteUrl/keyId/secret)

env.name: BRIDGISTIC_LOG_LEVEL
env.description: error | warn | info | debug (stderr only, never logs secrets)
